verdict.rationale: Filesystem persistence is documented: point-in-time directory snapshots can be saved to R2 and restored later, buckets can be mounted for data that persists across sandbox lifecycles, and a stable ID lets you reconnect to the same sandbox. Nothing in the pack shows a pause/resume primitive that keeps memory or process state, and a community commenter says it is unclear what filesystem persistence means once a container goes idle. missing for 10: an explicit pause/resume API, preservation of memory and process state across a pause, whole-sandbox (not just directory) snapshots, and independent hands-on confirmation of persistence behavior.
